subject: dwarfBlacksmith
pitch:
Category: Humanoid character.
Subject: dwarf blacksmith at an anvil.
Style: Blizzard/Warcraft.

requests.what: Add a bold bronze-and-steel helmet crest: a central riveted ridge, two short side fins, and a tiny glowing orange forge rune. Keep the face and beard unobstructed.
Add eight oversized brass rivets and engraved angular trim along both shoulder guards. Use warm brass, dark iron seams, and a few turquoise patina marks.
Add a broad leather tool belt over the apron with three pouches, a brass buckle, hanging tongs, and two short metal files. Keep the center of the apron clear.
Add three chunky ginger beard braids with dark leather ties and brass bead caps. The central braid should be longest and end just above the belt.
Add a handful of tiny orange-hot sparks and a thin ember glow around the anvil face, plus three small glowing runes on the front apron of the anvil.
Decorate the hammer with a dark iron head, a bright steel striking face, a brass collar, and two carved orange forge marks. Keep it chunky and readable.
Add large square brass buckles, iron toe caps, and two rows of tiny pale studs on each heavy boot.
Place a large angular blacksmith guild emblem on the anvil face: a crossed hammer and tongs inside a hexagonal brass outline.
Paint the dwarf's exposed skin in warm ruddy umber with lighter knuckles, nose, ears, and cheek planes. Add subtle cool shadow tones under the brow and beard.
Paint the wool tunic deep charcoal blue with broad desaturated red-brown woven bands at the hem and sleeves.
Texture the leather apron with dark chestnut hide, broad worn vertical strokes, pale edge stitching, and a few soot-black heat scars.
Texture the anvil as battered blue-black iron: bright worn edges, shallow concentric hammer scars on the top plate, and warm orange reflected light near the front.
